verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs describe adding a custom tool to an agent by importing it and passing it to the agent constructor. Studio is the interface for building and testing tools, and the Mastra server runs locally, so writing your own tool and loading it into a local instance is a first-party, documented workflow. Missing for 10: the actual tool-definition format or schema is not shown in the evidence, there is no evidence of a separate skills or plugin packaging system, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of authoring custom tools.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally

citations.quote: Add a tool to an agent by importing the tool and passing it to the agent constructor as a tools object.
